negative_reviews.author: ruby nottidge
negative_reviews.text: I’ve been here 3 times and every time I’ve been here, the service has been terrible. Really long wait times for drinks and food, ended up waiting even longer for the bill. There’s a man that waits on tables, he has his hair in a bun and is quite muscular (didn’t catch his name) he was very rude, and gave us lip when we asked for chilli oil (that I’d already ordered), he went to bring out our food to the table and didn’t believe that we had ordered it so he quizzed us. When we asked him for the bill he was very dismissive, said he’d get someone and never did. We ended up asking 3 separate people for our bill, hence why it took so long. The male waiter was Very stand off-ish, and honestly he was terrible at his job. The girl with the ginger and blonde hair was so nice and such a diva. This place is clearly very very understaffed, even when they have an offer on and expect an influx of customers. Our drinks normally take about 25 minutes longer than the food, so this time we ordered wine to make sure there was very little to do in order to actually serve us our drinks. Won’t be going again, food is nice but that’s about it, nothing special. Wouldn’t recommend.

negative_reviews.author: kyrell rc
negative_reviews.text:
Service was ridiculous…

The only reason we visited was because of their £5 ramen deal advertised all over social media, so we thought we’d give it a go.

The service was honestly ridiculous. My sister and I received our food, but my boyfriend and cousin were left waiting around 30 minutes for theirs. We had to tell the staff multiple times that their food hadn’t arrived, only for a waiter to ask us if we were sure nothing had come out, despite the empty spaces on the table making that pretty obvious. My sister and I had literally finished our meals by the time their food arrived.

To make matters worse, we then waited around 20 minutes for the bill. We asked two members of staff, and one of them was walking back and forth serving other tables whilst seemingly ignoring us, despite making eye contact. We eventually had to get up and approach the staff ourselves just to get the bill.

There was a complete lack of care and attention throughout the experience. The food itself was fine, but the service seriously let the whole visit down. I wouldn’t return based on this experience

negative_reviews.author: Teandre
negative_reviews.text: Probably wouldn’t go, potentially prejudice waitress. Completely neglected for over an hour, took 30 minutes to get the bill after asking twice the couple next to us were seated, served and paid their bill even though they came after us. Bear in mind we asked for our bill whilst they were still eating, we did more waiting than eating and the food was disgusting, not worth the price at all super bland and my sisters ramen was undercooked super hard noodles. don’t recommend.

Labour figure not final: two new chefs still to be added in Kobas, so labour will rise a little.

Management: Inka is looking to hire two AGMs and one supervisor; two AGM trials are this week (Wednesday and Thursday), with Inka on site Wednesday.

About half of the box of scratch pot vouchers has been given out.
Areas of improvement: delivery, reviews, morale and the management team; the training refresher is on Thursday and the GM will email the agenda to Inka today.

Sales were £912.39 lower week on week (more covers, less sales) and £7,545.05 (22.66%) ahead of target, at peak December level covers.
GM/HC doc: stock holding and food cost increased to about 30% only while app volume is high; agenda items were the new chefs, sous vide chicken, sushi and stock. The GM/HC meeting is on Wednesday.
Only one scratch card redemption was recorded in Nottingham out of 500 printed (Admin Meeting 19/10).
Sophie said the Nottingham team felt burned out early in the week but managed output without missing orders (Admin Meeting 19/10).

Birmingham FOH's app download approach is being applied in Nottingham, where freshers and student nights drive loyalty sign ups; the Nottingham promotion ends at the end of October with redemptions valid to the end of November (Birmingham Project Meeting 16/10).
Service was hit by iPad scanning errors and a temporary Diet Coke gas outage (AM Updates 21/10).
Nottingham used £10,000 more in discounts than any other site while still generating high revenue per cover (AM Updates 21/10).
Amy is driving B2B partnerships in Nottingham (AM Updates 21/10).
Flies in the toilets need pest control (Operations feedback meeting 21/10).
Region: Michael made rider wait time the priority delivery metric this week, followed by ratings; sites need a 4.7 Deliveroo rating to compete and open times above 99.5% (AM Updates 21/10).
Region: GMs and head chefs must run a daily morning brief for FOH and BOH using the app's daily tab to review sales, delivery ratings and setups (AM Updates 21/10).
